title: Banke activists’ 42nd-day sit-in at Maitighar

title: Paro vegetable vendors’ request to operate during lockdown
date: 2022-01-28 (report date; request date and form unknown)
reason: The captured BBS search result reports vendors asking the Dzongkhag COVID task force to allow them to operate; it does not establish a public gathering, strike, or other protest event. The 80 vendors reported as rotating through the market are not a documented event turnout.
notes: Provisional exclusion from search-result evidence only. The body open returned a web-tool cache miss; one ordinary request to the exact URL later failed DNS before HTTP, so whether the request was submitted at a meeting or in writing remains unresolved. Do not interpret this as evidence that no gathering occurred.
